body:
## Summary

Fixes #3445.

The [v2.37.1 release notes](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/releases/tag/v2.37.1) showed one bullet followed by 19 loose paragraphs. In `CHANGELOG.md` the same text is one list item. `scripts/format-release-notes.mjs` called `.trim()` on every line. That removed the two-space indentation `@changesets/changelog-git` gives the later lines of a changeset, so under CommonMark §5.2 those paragraphs and nested bullets fell out of the list item.

An audit of all 893 releases against `CHANGELOG.md` found the same bug in 302 releases (v0.38.9 to v2.37.1). It also found five more defects in the same pipeline:

- text cut at the first `---` or `###`;
- the first `- <hash>:` marker consumed by the old Patch-only regex;
- a literal `\n` turned into a line break;
- trailing quotes stripped;
- Minor and Major releases never formatted at all.

The publication sanitizer also masked option and identifier names, such as `--tokens-budget-stats` and `KNOWN_LOCAL_TOKEN_ENV_VARS`, in the v2.33.5 and v2.33.6 notes.

The full case study is in [`docs/case-studies/issue-3445/README.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-3445-7cd6fd7f1b0b/docs/case-studies/issue-3445/README.md). It covers the timeline, the requirements, root causes RC1–RC4, the audit, the repair, existing tools and research, and how to reproduce.

## Changes

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `scripts/format-release-notes.lib.mjs` (new) | Pure helpers. They keep indentation and every `### Major/Minor/Patch Changes` section; find sections only by headings at the start of a line; strip only the footer this formatter adds; and expose `findFormattingDefects`, `planReleaseRepair` and `formatChangelogListItem`. The footer pattern has no nested quantifier, which fixes the CodeQL alert raised on this PR. |
| `scripts/format-release-notes.mjs` | Uses the library. Adds `--verbose` / `VERBOSE`, which logs the sections, hashes and PRs found. |
| `scripts/create-github-release.mjs` | Takes the section by the whole `## <version>` line, so `2.3.1` no longer matches `## 2.3.10`. |
| `scripts/instant-version-bump.mjs` | Indents later lines of a multi-line manual description the way Changesets does, so `CHANGELOG.md` itself is correct. |
| `src/credential-sanitization-core.lib.mjs` | Fixes the four false positives. Real credentials next to them are still masked. |
| `scripts/repair-release-notes.mjs` (new) | Rebuilds published releases from `CHANGELOG.md`. It is a dry run by default; `--apply` updates the releases and `--backup-dir` saves the old bodies. |
| `tests/issue-3445-*.test.mjs`, `tests/test-format-release-notes-1271.mjs` | Regression tests (see below). |
| Dockerfiles, `src/formal-ai-version.lib.mjs`, two pin tests | formal-ai 0.353.8 → 0.354.0. The dependency freshness gate failed this PR's CI ([run 39019944968](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/39019944968)) because a new formal-ai version was published in the meantime. 0.354.0 has no `openssl-sys` in Cargo.lock and needs rust-version 1.99; its changes don't touch `/health`, `--version` or the server routes. |
| `.changeset/release-notes-formatting-3445.md` | The one patch changeset. |

## Repair of the published releases

All damaged releases were repaired with `scripts/repair-release-notes.mjs`. The logs are in [`docs/case-studies/issue-3445/repair/`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/tree/issue-3445-7cd6fd7f1b0b/docs/case-studies/issue-3445/repair):

- **Dry run against the backup:** 366 to repair:
  - 221 lost indentation;
  - 81 lost indentation and missing text;
  - 21 missing text;
  - 37 unformatted;
  - 6 different from `CHANGELOG.md`.
- **v2.37.1** was repaired first. Then the bulk `--apply` run checked 894 releases and repaired 365, with 0 failures.
- **v2.38.0** was published with the old formatter while this PR was open, and was repaired separately.
- **Verification dry run on the live releases:** 0 left to repair (592 correct, 302 with no CHANGELOG section, all from before v0.38.9).

The old bodies of all releases are backed up in `data/all-releases.json`.

Note: until this PR is merged, any new release still goes through the old formatter. If one is published before the merge, run `node scripts/repair-release-notes.mjs --apply` once after merging.

GitHub's render of v2.37.1 (`POST /markdown`, `gfm` mode):

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-3445-7cd6fd7f1b0b/docs/case-studies/issue-3445/render/v2.37.1-before.png?raw=true) | ![after](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-3445-7cd6fd7f1b0b/docs/case-studies/issue-3445/render/v2.37.1-after.png?raw=true) |

## Upstream report

Every copy of the formatter comes from the pipeline template. I filed the bug there as https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/236. It includes a repro, a workaround and a suggested code change.

This PR only references that issue. It does not close it, because the template's own copy of the formatter is fixed in the template repository, not here.

## How to reproduce

1. Audit the live releases against `CHANGELOG.md`. Before the repair: 302 lost indentation, 102 missing text, 37 unformatted, 6 other. After: 0 defects.
   ```bash
   gh api repos/link-assistant/hive-mind/releases --paginate --jq '[.[] | {id, tag_name, published_at, body}]' | jq -s add > /tmp/releases.json
   node experiments/issue-3445-audit-releases.mjs /tmp/releases.json > /tmp/audit.tsv
   ```
2. `node tests/issue-3445-release-notes-formatting.test.mjs` runs the formatter's tests.
   - It reproduces the old line-trimming formatter on the real v2.37.1 section, and checks that its output has the flattened structure.
   - It checks that the new formatter keeps the section exactly.
   - It covers several sections, Major releases, `---`/`###` inside the text, CRLF, idempotence, the repair plan, the `formatChangelogListItem` CHANGELOG writer, and a footer regex that stays linear on long runs of blank lines.
3. `node tests/issue-3445-release-notes-not-masked.test.mjs` runs the sanitizer false-positive tests.

## Tests

- **Local:**
  - Pass: `issue-3445-release-notes-formatting`, `issue-3445-release-notes-not-masked`, `test-format-release-notes-1271`, the release and sanitizer tests (`check-release-needed-2175`, `release-*`, `issue-2397-*`, `test-token-sanitization`, `test-credential-sanitization-2111`, `test-issue-2189-*`), `formal-ai-tool-parity-3279`, `test-issue-2187-current-dependency-pins`, `scripts/check-dependency-freshness.mjs`, `scripts/validate-changeset.mjs`, `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check`.
  - Fail on both `main` and this branch under local Node 26 only: `deliberate-draft-restarts-ai-2312` and `test-merge-changesets-1452`. This PR doesn't cause them.
  - The full local suite was stopped by the session's time limit at 246 of 671 test files.
- **CI:** "Checks and release" [run 39021165357](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/39021165357) passes on 2ba255339, including test-suites and the dependency freshness gate. Security (CodeQL) and Broken Link Checker also pass.
